title: Betopia Group
description: betopiagroup.com Betopia Group Betopia Group is a Bangladeshi tech holding based in Dhaka, formally created in July 2025 by consolidating 22 business units including Bdcalling IT, Softvence, Sparktech, JVAI and Zencore, claiming 5,000 employees and 36 million dollars in annual revenue. Founded by Muhammad Monir Hossain, who went from freelancing on oDesk in 2013 to launching Bdcalling IT in 2017 with just 500,000 taka and 7 people, the group now serves clients in over 80 countries with 80 to 90 percent of business from the United States. Its units span software development, AI, cloud infrastructure via ZenexCloud, Odoo ERP implementation, renewable energy through PulseGrid and IT education. In July 2026 the group unveiled Vision 2030, planning to double its workforce and build Betopia City, an AI-powered smart tech hub in Bangladesh. The company is embroiled in a major scandal, with Fiverr suspending around 300 accounts linked to Betopia for coordinated marketplace manipulation.
